commits.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"
    android:id="@+id/rootContainer"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:background="#0D1117"
    tools:context=".main.MainActivity">

    <!-- Top: Map Section -->
    <FrameLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1.2">

    <!-- MapView will be added programmatically based on selected provider -->
    <FrameLayout
        android:id="@+id/mapContainer"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent">
        
        <!-- OSMDroid MapView (default, will be removed if Mapbox is selected) -->
        <org.osmdroid.views.MapView
            android:id="@+id/mapView"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="match_parent" />
    </FrameLayout>
    
        <!-- Official ManeuverView (portrait: full width, top-left) -->
        <FrameLayout
            android:id="@+id/maneuverContainer"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_gravity="top|start"
            android:layout_marginStart="@dimen/hud_maneuver_margin_start_portrait"
            android:layout_marginEnd="@dimen/hud_maneuver_margin_end_portrait"
            android:layout_marginTop="@dimen/hud_maneuver_margin_top_portrait"
            android:maxWidth="@dimen/hud_maneuver_max_width_portrait"
            android:background="@drawable/bg_map_controls_pill"
            android:clipToOutline="true"
            android:outlineProvider="background"
            android:visibility="gone">

            <com.mapbox.navigation.ui.components.maneuver.view.MapboxManeuverView
                android:id="@+id/maneuverView"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:paddingEnd="0dp" />
        </FrameLayout>

        <!-- Legacy custom maneuver layout (OSMDroid/manual flow) -->
    <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
        android:id="@+id/maneuverViewContainer"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="#E6202123"
        app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
            app:cardElevation="0dp">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:padding="12dp"
            android:gravity="center_vertical">

            <ImageView
                android:id="@+id/ivManeuverIcon"
                android:layout_width="48dp"
                android:layout_height="48dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_turn_straight"
                app:tint="#FFFFFF" />

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                android:orientation="vertical">

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvManeuverDistance"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="500 m"
                    android:textColor="#FF6020"
                    android:textSize="24sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvManeuverPrimary"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="Continue"
                    android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                    android:textSize="16sp"
                    android:maxLines="2"
                    android:ellipsize="end" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvManeuverSecondary"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text=""
                    android:textColor="#A0A0A0"
                    android:textSize="13sp"
                    android:maxLines="1"
                    android:ellipsize="end"
                    android:visibility="gone" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </LinearLayout>
    </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

        <!-- Map controls (top-right) -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:id="@+id/mapControlsContainer"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_gravity="top|end"
            android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="200dp"
            android:background="@drawable/bg_map_controls_pill"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:paddingHorizontal="8dp"
            android:paddingVertical="8dp"
            android:gravity="center_horizontal">

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnOrientationToggle"
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:contentDescription="@string/map_control_orientation"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_unlock"
                android:padding="6dp"
                app:tint="#FFFFFF" />

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnCameraNorthMode"
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:contentDescription="@string/map_control_heading_mode"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_map_heading"
                android:padding="6dp"
                app:tint="#FFFFFF" />

            <!-- Navigation-only controls -->
            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnOverview"
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:contentDescription="Overview"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_route"
                android:padding="6dp"
                android:visibility="gone"
                app:tint="#FFFFFF" />

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/btnRecenter"
                android:layout_width="40dp"
                android:layout_height="40dp"
                android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:contentDescription="Recenter"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_navigation"
                android:padding="6dp"
                android:visibility="gone"
                app:tint="#FFFFFF" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <!-- Bottom HUD (portrait: speed left, pills right, angle above pills for motorcycle) -->
        <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
            android:id="@+id/bottomHudRow"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_gravity="bottom"
            android:paddingStart="0dp"
            android:paddingEnd="@dimen/hud_bottom_row_padding_end_portrait"
            android:paddingBottom="0dp"
            android:layout_marginStart="@dimen/hud_bottom_row_margin_start_portrait"
            android:layout_marginBottom="@dimen/hud_bottom_row_margin_bottom_portrait"
            android:clipToPadding="false">

            <!-- Speed overlay (left) -->
            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/speedOverlayContainer"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"

                android:orientation="horizontal"
                android:gravity="center_vertical"
                app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/speedTextCar"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:minWidth="@dimen/hud_speed_min_width_portrait"
                    android:gravity="center"
                    android:paddingHorizontal="12dp"
                    android:paddingVertical="12dp"
                    android:background="@drawable/bg_speed_circle"
                    android:text="0"
                    android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                    android:textSize="28sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"/>
            </LinearLayout>

            <!-- Trip progress pills (portrait: right-aligned) -->
            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/tripProgressContainer"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:background="@drawable/bg_map_controls_pill"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:orientation="horizontal"
                android:paddingHorizontal="@dimen/hud_trip_padding_h_portrait"
                android:paddingVertical="@dimen/hud_trip_padding_v_portrait"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:gravity="center"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:minWidth="@dimen/hud_trip_value_min_width_portrait">

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvTripEta"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:minWidth="@dimen/hud_trip_value_min_width_portrait"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:singleLine="true"
                        android:ellipsize="none"
                        android:text="--:--"
                        android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                        android:textSize="@dimen/hud_trip_value_text_size_portrait"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvTripEtaLabel"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:text="ETA"
                        android:textColor="#E0E0E0"
                        android:textSize="@dimen/hud_trip_label_text_size_portrait" />
                </LinearLayout>

                <View
                    android:layout_width="1dp"
                    android:layout_height="32dp"
                    android:layout_marginHorizontal="@dimen/hud_trip_separator_margin_h_portrait"
                    android:background="#33FFFFFF" />

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:gravity="center"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:minWidth="@dimen/hud_trip_value_min_width_portrait">

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvTripRemainingTime"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:minWidth="@dimen/hud_trip_value_min_width_portrait"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:singleLine="true"
                        android:ellipsize="none"
                        android:text="--:--"
                        android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                        android:textSize="@dimen/hud_trip_value_text_size_portrait"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvTripRemainingTimeLabel"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:text="time"
                        android:textColor="#E0E0E0"
                        android:textSize="@dimen/hud_trip_label_text_size_portrait" />
                </LinearLayout>

                <View
                    android:layout_width="1dp"
                    android:layout_height="32dp"
                    android:layout_marginHorizontal="@dimen/hud_trip_separator_margin_h_portrait"
                    android:background="#33FFFFFF" />

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:gravity="center"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:minWidth="@dimen/hud_trip_value_min_width_portrait">

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvTripRemainingDistance"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:minWidth="@dimen/hud_trip_value_min_width_portrait"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:singleLine="true"
                        android:ellipsize="none"
                        android:text="--"
                        android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                        android:textSize="@dimen/hud_trip_value_text_size_portrait"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvTripRemainingDistanceLabel"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:text="km"
                        android:textColor="#E0E0E0"
                        android:textSize="@dimen/hud_trip_label_text_size_portrait" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </LinearLayout>
            
            <!-- Motorcycle portrait: gauge + lean angle stacked ABOVE the pills -->
            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/angleContainerMoto"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:visibility="gone"
                android:layout_marginBottom="5dp"
                app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="@+id/tripProgressContainer"
                app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@+id/tripProgressContainer">

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/angleTextMoto"
                    android:layout_width="75dp"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:paddingHorizontal="16dp"
                    android:paddingVertical="10dp"
                    android:textAlignment="center"
                    android:background="@drawable/bg_angle_pill"
                    android:text="0°"
                    android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                    android:textSize="20sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"/>

                <com.example.clinometer.LinearGaugeView
                    android:id="@+id/linearGaugeView"
                    android:layout_width="@dimen/hud_angle_gauge_width_portrait"
                    android:layout_height="16dp"
                    android:layout_marginTop="5dp" />
        </LinearLayout>

            <!-- Landscape-specific elements (always GONE in portrait) -->
            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/angleLandscapeContainer"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="0dp"
                android:visibility="gone" />

            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/carActionButtonsOverlay"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="0dp"
                android:visibility="gone" />
        </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

        <!-- Landscape-specific elements (always GONE in portrait) -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:id="@+id/carStatsOverlay"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:visibility="gone" />
    </FrameLayout>

    <!-- Bottom: Dashboard (portrait only) -->
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
    android:id="@+id/dashboardContainer"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:background="@color/transparent"
    android:paddingHorizontal="12dp"
    android:paddingTop="6dp"
    android:paddingBottom="12dp">

<!-- Main Content Area -->
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
    android:id="@+id/contentArea"
    android:layout_width="360dp"
    android:layout_height="250dp"
    app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/distanceContainer"
    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
    app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

    <!-- Speedometer Background -->
    <ImageView
        android:id="@+id/speedometerBackground"
        android:layout_width="236dp"
        android:layout_height="217dp"
        android:src="@drawable/speedometer_circle"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintDimensionRatio="1:1"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintHeight_max="270dp"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintWidth_max="270dp"
                app:tint="#2E3950" />

    <!-- Gauge View -->
    <com.example.clinometer.GaugeView
        android:id="@+id/gaugeView"
        android:layout_width="236dp"
        android:layout_height="250dp"
        android:padding="0dp"
        android:visibility="gone"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintDimensionRatio="1:1"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintHeight_max="270dp"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintVertical_bias="0.0"
        app:layout_constraintWidth_max="270dp" />

    <!-- Speed Display -->
    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/speedText"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-thin"
        android:shadowColor="@color/primary_color"
        android:shadowRadius="10"
        android:text="0"
        android:textAlignment="center"
        android:textColor="@color/primary_color"
        android:textSize="48sp"
        android:textStyle="bold"
        android:paddingLeft="12dp"
        android:paddingRight="12dp"
        android:paddingTop="0dp"
        android:paddingBottom="6dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintVertical_bias="0.29" />

    <!-- Angle Display -->
    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/currentAngleText"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:paddingHorizontal="12dp"
        android:paddingVertical="4dp"
        android:text="0°"
        android:textAlignment="center"
        android:textColor="@color/primary_color"
        android:textSize="20sp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="@+id/speedometerBackground"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="@+id/speedometerBackground"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="@+id/speedometerBackground"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@+id/speedText"
        app:layout_constraintVertical_bias="0.09"
        app:layout_constraintHorizontal_bias="0.500"/>

    <!-- Timer -->
    <Chronometer
        android:id="@+id/chronometer"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="-35dp"
        android:textAlignment="center"
        android:textColor="@color/primary_color"
        android:textSize="18sp"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="@+id/speedometerBackground"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="@+id/speedometerBackground"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@+id/speedometerBackground" />
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

<!-- Car Mode Stats (visible for car profiles) -->
<LinearLayout
    android:id="@+id/carModeContainer"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:orientation="horizontal"
    android:gravity="center_vertical"
    android:background="@drawable/bg_car_mode_stats"
    android:paddingHorizontal="20dp"
    android:paddingVertical="10dp"
    android:visibility="gone"
    android:layout_marginBottom="4dp"
    app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/buttonContainer"
    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center">

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/distanceTextCar"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="0.00"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
            android:textSize="22sp"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"/>

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="km"
            android:textColor="@color/primary_color"
            android:textSize="14sp"/>
    </LinearLayout>

    <View
        android:layout_width="1dp"
        android:layout_height="28dp"
        android:layout_marginHorizontal="16dp"
        android:background="#33FFFFFF"/>

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center">

        <Chronometer
            android:id="@+id/chronometerCar"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
            android:textSize="22sp"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
            android:gravity="center"/>

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="time"
            android:textColor="@color/primary_color"
            android:textSize="14sp"/>
    </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>

<!-- Distance Display (Motorcycle only) -->
<LinearLayout
    android:id="@+id/distanceContainer"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:gravity="center"
    android:orientation="horizontal"
    android:paddingVertical="8dp"
    app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/buttonContainer"
    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent">

    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/distanceText"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:text="Distance: 0.00 km"
        android:textSize="16sp"
        android:textColor="@color/primary_color"/>
</LinearLayout>

<!-- Button Container -->
<LinearLayout
    android:id="@+id/buttonContainer"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:orientation="horizontal"
    android:gravity="center"
    app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
    android:paddingHorizontal="16dp"
    android:paddingVertical="8dp">

    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnReset"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="48dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:layout_marginEnd="4dp"
        android:text="@string/reset_button"
        android:textColor="#000"
        android:textSize="12sp"
        app:backgroundTint="#FFF"
        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
        android:letterSpacing="0.1"
        android:stateListAnimator="@null"
        android:background="@drawable/rounded_button"/>

    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnZero"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="48dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:layout_marginStart="4dp"
        android:layout_marginEnd="4dp"
        android:text="@string/zero_button"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
        android:textSize="12sp"
        app:backgroundTint="#4CAF50"
        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
        android:letterSpacing="0.1"
        android:stateListAnimator="@null"
        android:background="@drawable/rounded_button"/>

    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnStop"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="48dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:layout_marginStart="4dp"
        android:text="@string/stop_button"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
        android:textSize="12sp"
        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
        android:letterSpacing="0.1"
        android:stateListAnimator="@null"
        android:background="@drawable/rounded_button"
        app:backgroundTint="#E53E3E"/>
</LinearLayout>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
    </LinearLayout>
